title: Binary tree array keeping empty slots
summary: Explicitly keep empty slots for missing intermediate nodes in the level-order array so the 2i+1 and 2i+2 mappings reconstruct the tree uniquely.
context: The 10 solid nodes are connected as follows: root 1 connects to left child 2 and right child 3; 2 connects only to left child 4; 3 connects to left child 6 and right child 7; 4 connects to left child 8 and right child 9; 6 connects only to left child 12; 7 connects only to right child 15; and 8, 9, 12, and 15 are leaf nodes. Array indices 0 through 14 span 15 cells holding 10 node values and five empty slots at indices 4, 9, 10, 12, and 13; the table below lists every cell.
result: Keeping intermediate empty slots explicitly lets child positions 2i+1 and 2i+2 for index i reconstruct this tree uniquely. An empty slot means no node exists there (often written None or null in code), not the numeric value 0.

frames.title: Binary tree array keeping empty slots
frames.explanation: Even though index 4 is an empty slot with no node, its two child positions 9 and 10 on the next level must also be left empty so later nodes do not shift forward out of place. For instance, node 6 at index 5 stores 12 at left child position 11 and has an empty right child position 12.
